integrity: Fully stated mathematical proof and reproducible exact-rational checking code; no independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the real unweighted edge ell_1 minimum cycle-space projection is classified for two-length path bundles. Euclidean orthogonality refers to unweighted edge ell_2. A comparison with inaccessible 1974 and 2014 minimal-hyperplane articles remains a bibliographic originality risk; the reduction to a weighted hyperplane is classical. The 28 exact-rational cases do not themselves prove the all-parameter result.
title: Sharp optimal and orthogonal cycle projections on two-length path bundles
